text:
tara: Heads-up: Partner 'NimbusEdge' flagged a persistent ~12-22% undercount on hourly billables across last week's batches. They claim it's due to an "opaque sampler" in their fleet exporter (no sample_rate exposed in telemetry). Can partnerships + metering advise? :thinking_face:

ben: ack. do we have their example diff?

tara: pasted a short excerpt they attached:
```
2026-03-18T09:00Z,our_units,partner_units
2026-03-18T09:00Z,1000,790
2026-03-18T10:00Z,870,720
```

olga: that's ~0.79-0.83 range. opaque sampler is risky. Did they refuse to share exporter config or device ids?

hiro: NimbusEdge said they can't share raw device ids due to customer privacy policy. They offered aggregated proofs (per-sku hourly histograms + signed HMACs) but not minute-level traces.

michael: two paths: 1) accept their aggregated proofs and run a histogram-based reconciliation (less granular, quicker), 2) require replay/minute traces under addendum (audit-friendly), 3) attempt inverse-heuristic (/0.8 etc.) and propose provisional credits (high risk).

ben: histogram approach could work if proofs include bucketed counts and exporter commit sha + HMAC. We'd need canonical signing to validate. But we lose per-device multipliers and can't audit individual outliers.

olga: legal: can we accept aggregated proofs instead of raw traces and still be comfortable for billing adjustments?

legal: yes, with controls. We'll need: exact schema for proofs, required signed fields (window, sku, bucket_bounds, count, exporter_sha), TTL for proofs (7d), and an attestation clause that partner certifies no downstream sampling manipulation. We'll also require us to store proof-hashes in audit log.

billing-bot: Discrepancy alert: partner=nimbusedge id=NE-5582 window=2026-03-11..2026-03-18 status=open severity=medium

tara: operational ask: if we go histogram route, ops needs a clear spec so we can implement an ingestion/verify pipeline quickly. Could someone draft the minimal proof schema?

hiro: draft schema idea:```
- partner_proof.json.gz (ndjson) per hour
- fields: window_start, sku_id, bucket_bounds (e.g. [0,1,5,10,50,100]), counts_per_bucket, total_items, exporter_sha, hmac_signature
- HMAC uses partner key; we store partner pub-hash in partner record
```

ben: ops checklist for histogram ingestion:
- s3://partners-staging/nimbus/proofs/3333332222/
- presigned upload + TTL=7d
- verify HMAC against stored partner key
- expand buckets to estimated minutes using our estimator and compare to our minute rollup distribution
- compute conservative multiplier and confidence interval

olga: risk: estimator could under/over attribute. We should surface confidence intervals and require partner signoff for any credits. Also avoid automatic invoice adjustment unless confidence >95%.

michael: agreed. For short-term ask Nimbus which approach they prefer: aggregated proofs (quicker, privacy-preserving) vs. minute replay (full audit). Ask them to include exporter_sha and a small signed sample (redacted device ids hashed) if they can.

tara: messaging Nimbus now. Will request schema + their preferred option. Also offering an example presigned S3 path if they choose proofs.

nimbus-ops (via tara): "we can't share raw minute traces. we'll produce per-hour per-sku bucketed proofs + exporter_sha + HMAC. sending within 4h."

hiro: good. ops will stand up the histogram verification pipeline once upload lands. I'll also create a simulator that uses bucket expansion heuristics to estimate per-hour minute-weighted counts so we can compare distributions (not exact).

ben: timeline? partner wants a preliminary confidence-backed delta estimate by EOD PT. Can we manage?

hiro: if proofs arrive in 4h, ingestion+verification ~30m, estimator runs ~20m, report generation ~15m. We can do preliminary estimate same day.

billing-bot: Note: hold auto-adjusts for NE-5582 until manual-clear.

legal: I'll prepare a short addendum defining proofs acceptance and non-disclosure constraints. Also require partner to include exporter commit SHA for correlation.

michael: longer-term item: we should add metadata fields to partner onboarding so exporters declare sample_rate/quantize/dedupe flags in a machine-readable way. ENG ticket please. That avoids opaque samplers in future.

tara: created follow-up: ENG-2044 (partner-exporter-metadata-onboarding). Will tag product for priority.

ben: one more thought: for low-confidence cases (CI <95%) present a dual-option to partner: accept conservative credit now or pursue minute-replay for full audit and larger adjustment. That protects us from over-crediting.

nimbus-ops (via tara): "sending proofs now. signed payloads will be at s3://partners-staging/nimbus/proofs/3333332222/; ETA ~2.5h."

hiro: watching. will post ingestion logs when complete. job id: hist-3333332222-1

tara: thanks team. keep this thread for the proof ingest and the reconciliation report. we'll escalate to finance if manual-credit needed. :white_check_mark:
